nodes.description: Total token supply state variable, mutated by _mint and _burn.
Mapping of account balances, written by _transfer and _mint.
Nested mapping of owner/spender allowances, written by _approve.
Token name string set once in the ERC20 constructor.
Token symbol string set once in the ERC20 constructor.
Generator version string, exposed by version().
Payable constructor of SimpleERC20; validates initialBalance_ and mints the whole supply to _msgSender().
Internal mint routine that increases _totalSupply and credits _balances[account]; triggers _beforeTokenTransfer hook.
Internal transfer routine that debits sender and credits recipient balances; triggers _beforeTokenTransfer hook.
External transferFrom implementation; checks and reduces allowance for _msgSender() before transferring.
External transfer implementation; moves tokens from _msgSender() to recipient.
Payable constructor that forwards msg.value to an arbitrary receiver via IPayable(receiver).pay(...).
Caller-controlled address returned by _msgSender(), used for transfers and mint recipient.
External call IPayable(receiver).pay{value: msg.value}(serviceName) to a caller-supplied payable address during construction.
Empty virtual hook invoked before every mint, burn and transfer; overridable by derived contracts (callback surface).
Constructor parameter holding the initial supply minted to the deployer.
Constructor parameter passed to ServicePayer as the payable service fee receiver.
Constructor parameter forwarded to the ERC20 constructor as token name.
Constructor parameter forwarded to the ERC20 constructor as token symbol.
_mint parameter naming the balance to credit.
_mint parameter holding the number of tokens created.
Local snapshot of _balances[sender] used to subtract the transferred amount in _transfer.
Local snapshot of the caller allowance used in transferFrom and decreaseAllowance.
Arithmetic reassignment of balances and total supply (_totalSupply += amount, _balances[a] += amount, _balances[s] = senderBalance - amount, allowance subtraction).
Returns msg.sender; the single origin of caller identity used across ERC20.

edges.reason: _msgSender() returns the untrusted msg.sender value.
The deployer address from _msgSender() becomes the _mint recipient in the constructor.
SimpleERC20 constructor invokes _mint(_msgSender(), initialBalance_).
initialBalance_ parameter drives the minted supply in the constructor.
name_ parameter is forwarded to the ERC20 constructor.
symbol_ parameter is forwarded to the ERC20 constructor.
ERC20 constructor writes name_ into _name.
ERC20 constructor writes symbol_ into _symbol.
_mint performs unchecked-in-source arithmetic _totalSupply += amount and _balances[account] += amount.
Arithmetic increment updates the _totalSupply state variable.
Arithmetic updates debit/credit entries inside the _balances mapping.
_mint credits the recipient entry of _balances.
_mint calls the virtual _beforeTokenTransfer hook that derived contracts may override with arbitrary logic.
_transfer calls the virtual _beforeTokenTransfer hook before balances are settled.
_transfer computes senderBalance - amount and adds amount to the recipient balance.
Local senderBalance is read from _balances[sender] at the start of _transfer.
senderBalance is the left operand of the balance subtraction that writes back to _balances.
_transfer writes the debited sender and credited recipient entries of _balances.
transfer() derives the sender from _msgSender() and passes it into _transfer.
transferFrom() calls _transfer(sender, recipient, amount) before touching the allowance.
transferFrom reads _allowances[sender][_msgSender()] into the local currentAllowance.
currentAllowance - amount is written back into the _allowances state mapping via _approve.
feeReceiver_ parameter is passed into the ServicePayer constructor as the payable receiver.
ServicePayer constructor performs an external payable call to the caller-supplied receiver address.

normalization_plan.reason: Constructor parameter only carries the minted supply; fold its value into the constructor node.
Payable receiver parameter is used solely to invoke the external pay() call from the ServicePayer constructor.
Token name parameter is immediately forwarded to the ERC20 constructor.
Token symbol parameter is immediately forwarded to the ERC20 constructor.
Mint recipient parameter is fully determined by the _mint call site and its caller.
Mint amount parameter only feeds the arithmetic reassignment inside _mint.
Local balance snapshot exists only inside _transfer and disappears after normalization.
Local allowance snapshot exists only inside transferFrom/decreaseAllowance.
